profile.summary: The University of California is a public university system with 10 campuses, 6 academic health centers and 3 national laboratories, serving over 300,000 students. Its Office of the President, in Oakland, is the system headquarters and runs systemwide programs, including UC Compass, which gives California school districts data on student progress toward UC and CSU course requirements.
